claim_scope: Durable cross-session project state and same-mission checkpoint/relaunch continuity: preserve committed work, identity, task and mission bindings across process/context loss; resume without reexecuting completed work; continue to terminal completion.

target_basis.target: Claude Opus 5.5 useful long-horizon memory/continuity behavior
target_basis.useful_behavior: Use memory across sessions, preserve project state and resume long-running work coherently.
target_basis.comparison_rule: Because no public numeric memory benchmark is defined in the canonical target envelope, promotion is limited to objective persistence/continuity conditions with binary exact ground truth. No qualitative memory-intelligence superiority is inferred.

durable_authority: Git-backed canonical task and mission manifests

corroborating_primary_evidence.fact: Controller resumed from checkpoint with resume_count=1 and completed.
Checkpoint rewind/reexecution preserved the mission and completed deterministically.
Fresh second invocation completed after checkpoint; same agent/task identity remained bound; full test surface passed.
Genuine later-chat context resumed completed work without reexecution.

frontier_bar.definition: Exact preservation of committed state/identity/mission and exactly-once continuation across a forced process boundary for the tested continuity class.
frontier_bar.reasoning: For the verified persistence predicates, correctness is binary: the bound state, identity, task, mission and prior work are either preserved exactly and resumed correctly or they are not. The Brain route reached the ceiling on the tested conditions. This does not imply superiority on semantic memory quality outside the tested scope.

decision.rationale: The operative continuity mechanism is Brain-owned, current exact bytes passed a fresh forced-process-boundary test at the objective persistence ceiling, prior genuine context-resume evidence corroborates coherent completed-work reuse, and an independent Wolfram clean-room adjudication proves provider/context-loss relaunch. No opaque model capability is required.

inheritance.future_routing_rule: For long-running Brain work requiring cross-session continuity, persist canonical mission/task/checkpoint state and resume through the same-identity supervisor before relying on opaque model memory.
